correctness.rationale: The six-conjunct existential matrix excludes y=0,x,2x,x/2,−x for each nonzero x. In C5 those are all five residues. In C_{5^k}, x=5^{k−2} and y=3x meet all nonzero-difference tests: y−2x=x, 2y−x=5x, x+y=4x, each not 0 mod 5^k. All single-variable atomic {R,e,=} diagrams in these odd cyclic groups depend only on whether the variable equals zero, so quantifier-rank <=1 sentences agree. Least rank is 2. Smallest divisor belonging to exactly one group order is 25, and floor(log2(25))=4. Independent exhaustive truth/atomic-type checks for C5,C25,C125,C625 corroborate this infinite algebraic proof. The original thesis theorem and exact relational-language scope were examined directly.

final_claim: In the first-order language with ternary relation R(a,b,c) iff a+b=c, named zero and equality, the least quantifier rank separating C5 and C_{5^k} is exactly 2 for every integer k>=2. An explicit existential two-variable sentence is false in C5, true in all higher five-powers, contradicting Gomaa 2007 Theorem 3.12(1) and corresponding 2010 numerical rank-at-least-four inference when the least differing order-divisor is f=25.
